input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) unconditionally. The return annotation is tuple[str, str], but self.help is None when no help text was set, so the second element can be None.
- rationale: Trigger: a command where one argument has help and another does not (so the section is shown). The old code substituted "" for the undocumented argument. Now format_help passes (metavar, None) to formatter.write_dl, which wraps or measures the description and raises a TypeError or AttributeError when it handles None. Impact: --help crashes for such commands.
critique: The finding names the same faulty operation: get_help_record returns self.help without a fallback, which yields None. It also gives the same failure path: a mixed documented/undocumented argument set leads to write_dl receiving None and crashing with a TypeError on --help.
